## Project Overview
This is a React Native Expo project for vehicle maintenance service registration using TypeScript, React Hook Form, and Material Design principles.

## Architecture Guidelines
- Follow clean architecture principles with clear separation of concerns
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Implement proper error handling and validation
- Use React Hook Form for form management
- Follow Material Design guidelines for UI/UX
- Use functional components with hooks
- Implement proper loading states and user feedback

## Coding Standards
- Use TypeScript strict mode
- Follow ESLint and Prettier configurations
- Use meaningful variable and function names
- Add proper JSDoc comments for complex functions
- Implement proper error boundaries
- Use proper folder structure as defined in src/

## UI/UX Guidelines
- Prioritize accessibility and usability
- Use consistent spacing and typography
- Implement smooth animations and transitions
- Provide clear visual feedback for user actions
- Follow mobile-first design principles
